chapter: WDSU radio and the New Orleans scene
title: Hearing Papa Celestin's band at WDSU
summary: His first Black band was Papa Celestin's, who came to the station for a session; Mazzari remembers the venerable old man.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Have you ever seen any colored bands around?

Mm-hmm. Not until recently, though, I'd heard about the colored bands, but somehow or other, I never seemed to have, you know, dug one until one day. And then, uh, Pete Loderman mentioned the fact that Papa Celestin was coming to the station to do a session. And so, naturally, I got all shook up because I was being my first colored band, you know. And sure enough, when comes this venerable old man, man, I'll never forget. And here comes these other cats, and they sit down there, and they start going, and that was a real wonderful experience. Oh, Papa, he's done going, huh?
